  3. Ichiran Ramen (multiple locations in Shinjuku) - tonkotsu ramen for around ¥890 per bowl.
  4. Totto Ramen (10-minute walk from Shinjuku Station) - chicken broth ramen for around ¥1,000 per bowl.
  5. Toriki (5-minute walk from Shinjuku Station) - average price per dish: ¥500-¥1,000.
  6. Yakiniku Jumbo Han no Daidokoro Bettei (10-minute walk from Shinjuku Station) - course menus starting from around ¥2,500.
